title: Trace production build dispatch contract

gcp_mumbai.data_residency: Workspace data must remain in asia-south1; provisioning fails on another region.

api_compatibility.workspace_location: A workspace exists entirely in one profile/location.
api_compatibility.migration: Offline canonical-event and attachment export/import followed by projection rebuild; no live cross-cloud reads.

model_registry.provider_boundary: Only the private model gateway receives provider credentials or URLs.

invariants: Attachments and immutable atom versions are the only factual truth.
Every projection is rebuildable and versioned with source anchors, checksums, model/prompt/index revision, and lineage.
Tenant and visibility policy is enforced before and after every index hit, in storage, queues, caches, and model calls.
No query-time or nightly worker may scan an entire workspace at production scale.
Retrieval returns raw evidence or abstains; graphs and summaries are never sufficient evidence alone.
LLMs create bounded, auditable derived proposals only; they never auto-create trusted topology.
Every worker is idempotent by workspace, input revision, configuration revision, and job kind.

release_gates.quality: A mechanism change needs +2 points complete-gold-evidence coverage with no more than 0.5 points citation-precision regression.
